title: Eval preflight hook + synthetic smoke tests for model pin/upgrade events
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: Add a lightweight, automated preflight verification layer that runs synthetic smoke evaluations every time a model version is pinned or upgraded (both catalog changes and customer-pinned overrides). This feature should produce a fast pass/fail signal, a small delta-quality summary vs the customer’s pinned baseline, and an SLO/cost estimate that attaches to the pin event. The preflight will be gated (opt-in per-catalog and per-customer) and should integrate with existing eval runners and the Console rollout UI.
background_and_motivation: Current model pin/upgrade flows rely on periodic eval runs or manual checks, which creates gaps where a pin can introduce regressions into production before full evaluation completes. Customers with strict quality requirements need a deterministic preflight signal that is fast (under 2 minutes) and cheap, and that can block/flag pins in the Console and via API/webhook flows. This ticket implements a pragmatic, low-cost preflight that provides early detection and automatable gate decisions.
proposal_summary: 1) Introduce a preflight webhook that the pin/upgrade controller calls synchronously to enqueue a short synthetic eval job. 2) Synthetic evals run a targeted subset of the customer's canonical prompt set plus a few universal probes (safety, hallucination, stop-conditions) against the candidate model and the recently pinned baseline. 3) Return a compact delta report (quality delta metrics, token cost delta, latency estimate) and a pass/fail flag based on configurable thresholds. 4) Surface the report in Console and return HTTP 2xx/4xx to indicate candidate acceptance or rejection. 5) Allow customers to opt into strict block-on-fail or non-blocking warn-only modes.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight webhook API is callable by pin controller and returns within 120 seconds for jobs under 50 examples
Preflight job compares candidate -> baseline across at least three metrics (response-safety, semantic-similarity, and latency) and reports a pass/fail decision
Console shows preflight status for catalog and customer-pinned changes and exposes a toggle for block vs warn modes
Audit log entry and eval artifact link (S3/drive) are created for every preflight run
Admin UI and API allow per-catalog and per-customer default preflight policy
Cost impact for running preflight on common pin workflows is estimated and documented (<=5% of current eval-run budget baseline)
Integration tests and an end-to-end sample workflow (pin -> preflight -> block/unblock) are included in the PR
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): enable preflight but run in warn-only mode for all catalog pins for 2 weeks; collect signal, tune thresholds. Phase 2 (pilot): enable block-on-fail for a small set of opt-in customers and specific catalog models. Phase 3 (general availability): enable per-customer defaults and expose policy in Console. Monitoring: track preflight pass rate, false-positive rate (manual override fraction), mean run time, and cost per run.
implementation_notes:
- Reuse existing eval runner microservice but add a synthetic-job mode with strict resource/time budget.
- Provide a compact result schema to keep webhook latency low (no large payloads in sync path).
- Preflight runner should run in a low-cost GPU class or CPU fallback to reduce cost for short probe runs.
- Store full artifacts asynchronously and return link in synchronous response.
- Handle transient infra failures with retry/backoff; decide on fail-open vs fail-closed per customer policy.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Preflight false positives could block safe upgrades. Mitigation: Start in warn-only mode and collect override telemetry before enabling block-on-fail.
Risk: Cost increase from frequent pins. Mitigation: Limit synthetic example set, provide per-catalog rate-limits, and charge to eval budget.
Risk: Latency in pin flow. Mitigation: Keep sync preflight time budget <= 120s; allow async post-commit postflight for extended analyses.
